tei:div.tei:p: de nas mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor la sbyang ba ni/ bgegs gtor rnams bshams/ bsang sbyang*/ 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs// gtor ma'am theb kyu gsum po rim gyis bskor la/ oṃ sarba bighnān bhyaḥ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥ sarba thā khaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛhṇe daṃ ba liṃ te swā hā/ ces lan gsum/ 'dir bgegs kyi tshogs gang yin pa de thams cad/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'dis tshim nas/ phan pa dang bde ba'i sems dang ldan pas gzhan du dengs shig /zhes pas sbyang ba'o/ oṃ sumbha sogs lan gsum bzlas shing rdo rje gsor la/ ting lo'am chang bu bskor/ 'dir bgegs kyi tshogs gang yin pa de thams cad/ gtor mas lam brngan/ ting lo lam sgron/ chang bu lam rgyags kyi tshul du khyer la/ sa yi phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du songs shig /ces pa ni/ zhi drag phyed mas sbyang ba'o// hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya byas nas bden stobs brjod la/ mthar drag po'i tshams rngams rol chen dang bcas pas skrod pa ni/ 'di ltar/ na mo/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ yi dam rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi= dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams kyis= sangs rgyas kyi= chos kyi= dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bden pa dang*/ kun rdzob rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis/ 'dir dkyil 'khor chen po sgrub cing mchod pa dang*/ dbang gi las rim la 'jug pa la/ bar du gcod par byed pa'i 'byung po gdon bgegs kyi rigs gang yin pa de dag /deng dpal he ru ka'i bka' thos pas/ sa'i (212)phyogs 'dir ma gnas par myur ba nyid du song shig

/gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag thams cad/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes las byung ba'i khro bo'i kha ṭwām̐ ga 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar ba 'dis khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par bya'o/ /ces dang*/ sumbha bzlas pas bgegs bskrad cing gtor ma phyi rol du dor te/ drag pos sbyang ba'o// bsdus pa mos na/ bka' bsgo ba yid kyis byas nas sngags tsam brjod do/ /bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad snying gar yi ge baṃ gyi rnam par gnas pa/ lte ba'i gtum mo 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis ded ste/ sna sgor sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam par gyur pa mdun gyi til la thim/ bsang sbyang*/ 'bar ba'i me'i nang du khro bo rdo rje mkha' 'gro rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa zhal gdangs pa'o// oṃ badzra ḍā ka kha kha khā hi/ sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmi ku ruṃ swā hā/ lan gsum brjod/ las kyi rdo rjes til g.yas g.yon du bskor nas/ /g.yas su me dang g.yon du chur dor bas/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i zhal du gsol ba dang rgya mtsho chen po skyur bar bsam/ mthar me yang chu nang du ldugs so// sdig pa sbyang ba'o// de nas me long bstan ste/ las bum blangs nas khrus gsol ba gyi ste/ ji ltar bltams pa nas/ shrī ye hūm̐/ 'di ni khrus mchog sogs dang*/ de bzhin gshegs dang sogs kyis rol chen dang bcas pas khrus gsol/ de dag sku la nas/ oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ kā ya bi sho dha na ye swā hā/ ces sku phyis phul/ stong gsum kun tu sogs/ de nas de la= sna tshogs dbang po'i= lhag bsam dag pa'i= srab 'jam yangs pa= sogs dri'i byug pa dang*/ gos dang rgyan yang 'bul te dri ma sbyang ba'o/ /na maḥs manta kā ya wā ka tsitta badzrā nāṃ/ na mo ma hā badzra kro dha ya ma hā daṃṣṭotka bhi ṣa ṇa bhai ra wa ra ya/ a si mu sa la/

par shu/ pā sha ha sta ya/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li kha kha khā hi khā hi/ hu lu hu lu/ tiṣṭha tiṣṭha/ bhandha bhandha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ gardza gardza/ bi spho ṭa ya/ sarba bighnāṃ bi nā ya ka /ma hā ga ṇa pa ni/ dzi wi tānta kā ra ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas srung ba'i 'khor lo skad cig gis gsal bar gyur/
